title.purpose: One current workspace title in the main header.

body.purpose: Short operational prose and transcript previews.

label.purpose: Field labels, status metadata, and section labels.

shadows.name: state-glow
shadows.purpose: Focus rings and small status dots.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact solid command button for the current primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(40% 0.09 255 / 0.27); border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(48% 0.155 255); color: oklch(98% 0.004 240); font: 540 0.78rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(58% 0.16 255); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(54% 0.12 255 / 0.14); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Small dot plus short state label. Never use a switch track for status; failed dictation must stay visible instead of collapsing back to Ready.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(38% 0.012 240 / 0.15); border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(94.5% 0.006 262 / 0.96); color: oklch(19% 0.01 240); } .ds-status-pill span { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(58% 0.13 166); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(54% 0.12 255 / 0.12); } .ds-status-pill p { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 400 0.76rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Shortcut Chip
components.description: Compact shortcut display using sans-serif key tokens.
components.css: .ds-shortcut-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 28px; padding: 3px 6px 3px 7px; border: 1px solid oklch(38% 0.012 240 / 0.15); border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(94% 0.005 262 / 0.86); color: oklch(32% 0.012 240); font: 400 0.73rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-shortcut-chip kbd { min-height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(42% 0.014 262 / 0.16); border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(92% 0.006 262); color: oklch(19% 0.01 240); font: 540 0.68rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Calm navigation row where hover, focus, and active use the same fixed 32px icon-cell geometry.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-tab { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 9px; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 3px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: oklch(19% 0.01 240); font: 500 0.82rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-tab span { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: oklch(32% 0.012 240); } .ds-sidebar-tab svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-sidebar-tab:hover span { border-color: oklch(38% 0.012 240 / 0.15); background: oklch(94% 0.004 240 / 0.86); } .ds-sidebar-tab.is-active span { border-color: oklch(54% 0.13 255 / 0.24); background: oklch(90% 0.042 255 / 0.66); color: oklch(43% 0.155 255); }

components.name: Toggle Row
components.description: Quiet settings toggle with a small native-feeling track.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(38% 0.012 240 / 0.15); border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(96% 0.003 240 / 0.86); color: oklch(19% 0.01 240); font: 530 0.8rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 30px; height: 17px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(30% 0.014 240 / 0.24); border-radius: 99px; background: oklch(99% 0.002 240 / 0.98); } .ds-toggle input::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 99px; background: oklch(51% 0.012 240); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-toggle input:checked { border-color: oklch(54% 0.16 255); background: oklch(90% 0.042 255 / 0.7); } .ds-toggle input:checked::before { transform: translateX(13px); background: oklch(43% 0.155 255); }

narrative.overview: Verba should feel like a precise desktop utility that stays behind the user's writing flow. The interface is compact, neutral, and operational: one primary action, short state labels, dense controls, and no promotional framing. Texture comes from disciplined material contrast, fine borders, steady state indicators, and the blue-to-mint identity used only where it communicates action or state.
keyCharacteristics: Compact desktop density with low-radius surfaces.
Restrained light and graphite themes with tinted neutrals.
Blue for primary actions and processing, mint for ready/recording/success.
Status uses small dots and icon changes, not fake switches or text bars.
Navigation selection uses one fixed 32px icon cell for hover, focus, and active states.
Recording feedback uses a tiny transparent dot-line overlay while active, a small spinner while processing, and an in-app toast/status message when capture fails.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Accent Rule
rules.body: Brand color must stay rare. If blue or mint dominates a screen, the interface is drifting into decorative AI-tool territory.

rules.name: The Native Tray Rule
rules.body: macOS tray assets are monochrome template icons. Do not use the colored app icon or a status text title in the menu bar.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Controls, nav items, transcript rows, and settings panels must not float. Use borders and tonal changes before shadows.

dos: Do keep the primary workflow visible: speak, process, insert.
Do use compact spacing, low radius, and short state labels.
Do keep tray status icon-only and monochrome.
donts: Don't use cute rounded controls, 3D button treatments, glass cards, purple gradients, or decorative texture.
Don't let header controls overflow outside the app window.
Don't use a tray title such as Idle, Ready, Recording, or Processing.
